card.summary: 476 model entries in /v1/models on 2026-11-10 (513 on 2026-10-22), 45 of them marked self_hosted true on 2026-10-22; every id probed answers from one backend...

record.tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client; curl against POST {base}/chat/completions
record.chaining: Pairs with batch jobs indifferent to model selection. The single shared backend is the constraining link, with accepted calls answering at a 96 percent rate.

limits.value: free account API key: 60 requests per minute and 1,000 requests per month; no keyless API limit is published
anonymous web use: 6,000 tokens per day, reset at midnight UTC; free account: 30,000 tokens per day

free_tier.stated: 476 model entries in /v1/models on 2026-11-10 (513 on 2026-10-22), 45 of them marked self_hosted true on 2026-10-22; every id probed answers from one backend, Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct
free_tier.notes: the catalogue carries prompt and completion prices of '0' per entry. The count 476 is the length of the models array on 2026-11-10; it was 513 on 2026-10-22

identity_cost.detail: No key required. Third-party endpoint tracking reports 194 of 732 calls answered over 10 days (27 percent), and 194 of the 202 calls accepted for served models (96 percent).

record.reliability_note: no substitution was observed inside a single run, but the model served never matches the model requested for any id other than the backend's own name
record.confidence_note: the substitution was measured three times in run 1 and twice in run 2, plus once with a different id. What remains unmeasured is whether any of the 45 self-hosted entries is served as named.

records.error_run2: empty content; reasoning field populated (901 chars); finish_reason=length

evidence.proved: qwen3-8b, qwen-coder and deepseek-r1 all echoed Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct in run 1; qwen3-8b and qwen-coder did so again in run 2
513 entries with prompt and completion prices of '0'; 45 carry self_hosted true; the first entries name qwen7b as 'Qwen 3.6 35B' and qwen-coder as 'Qwen 3.6 35B'
the Free plan row of the API request tiers table: 1,000 requests per month and 60 per minute per key
anonymous users get 6,000 tokens per day; the same page lists 30,000 per day for a free account and a reset at midnight UTC
evidence.quote: Anonymous users get 6,000 tokens per day.

evidence.proved: the documented API path needs an email-confirmed account and a Bearer key; the keyless call is not documented
evidence.quote: Sign up free at /signup/ and confirm your email - that unlocks the 30,000-token daily free pool. Open /account/?tab=api and click Generate.

evidence.proved: one POST with no Authorization header for qwen7b answered 200 with content NEEDLE-9K2X and echoed model Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct (not qwen7b); body free_ai_usage reports tokens_used 37, tokens_charged 37, source self_hosted; no rate-limit header was returned (headers: server nginx/1.18.0, content-length 822)
a keyless POST on 2026-11-10 for qwen7b answered 200 twice and echoed Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct with content 'pong' and 21 tokens (19 prompt, 2 completion)

record.notes: The catalogue is 513 names for approximately one backend. Any capacity or quality claim about free.ai is a claim about Qwen3-30B-A3B, and a benchmark keyed on the requested id would be attributed to a model that never ran.
record.binding_note: no quota binds above the scale: every id probed answered 200 with no key, in both runs. The failure here is substitution and not a ceiling, and substitution is not one of the six constraint kinds, so it is recorded in limits_note rather than forced into a kind that would misdescribe it
record.limits_note: The served model is the primary constraint: 513 catalogue names resolve to a single backend, Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct. Third-party testing recorded an accepted-only response rate of 194 out of 202 calls (96 percent), though requests do not receive the specifically requested model.
